name: word-in-gpt
description: View and edit Word .docx files with Word-level fidelity, together with the model.

interface.longDescription: Open any .docx file in a high-fidelity Word editor. The editor lays out pages the way Word does. You and the model edit the same open document, and every change saves back to the file.
